name: Tsukikusa Megumi
source:
A hardworking "talent" famous for her cheerful expressions and plentiful bust, she's very much in demand by movie and TV drama producers. A very kind girl, she always thinks of others and can't refuse when someone asks something of her.

[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/idols-galore-please-enjoy-the-idol.html]JAST USA[/url]]
